fieldNotes.location: Roster address '16200 Nisqualli Rd' and pin (34.485332,-117.310196) were wrong - landed in a Victorville residential neighborhood. Correct facility is the KDP (former Dr Pepper Snapple) West Coast beverage plant at 18180 Gateway Dr, Victorville CA 92394, inside the Southern California Logistics Airport (SCLA, former George AFB). Confirmed via Beverage Industry, ReliablePlant, ARCO National Construction and Yelp/CalStateDir/Waze listings. ~850,000 sq ft building (300k production + 550k warehouse) on 57 acres; opened ~2010-2011, ~$150M investment.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant is fully enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence with privacy screening (confirmed in multiple May 2025 Street View frames). A fenced production plant of this scale has controlled truck access. Truck gate classified TRUE on the strength of the continuous perimeter fence and entrance infrastructure visible in Street View, but flagged uncertain - no crisp close-up of the gate barrier was obtainable.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Classified TRUE - a large fenced beverage manufacturing plant (200+ employees) of this type typically staffs the truck entrance; structures consistent with an entrance check-in are visible near the SW entrance in May 2025 Street View. Flagged uncertain - the booth could not be definitively resolved in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split across two distinct building faces - a long W dock bank (production/warehouse shipping) and a long N dock bank fronting the large drop yard - functioning as separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock banks on both the W face and the N face; ~50+ band, exact total (~60-80) estimated from overhead.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard on the N side - dozens of trailers parked in rows on an unpaved/graded lot (~100+ trailers visible), well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large building (~850k sq ft combined production + warehouse). A small round-tank process/storage farm sits at the SW corner (part of the plant, not counted as a separate building).
fieldNotes.railServed: SCLA is a multimodal hub with rail in the broader area, but no rail spur was observed entering this property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant sits inside the SCLA logistics park on the isolated NE desert edge of Victorville, away from the dense town fabric. Classified Rural per the rubric's edge-of-town guidance; flagged uncertain because Victorville is a sizable city and SCLA is a developed logistics park.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Set false - SCLA is a major built-up logistics/airport hub with infrastructure despite the desert edge location.
